title: REQ · BootScene has a single sceneObjects field and keeps its behavior
summary: Only one private sceneObjects field remains and the scene still builds, syncs and cleans up objects
description: Context: BootScene.ts lines 22 and 23 both declare `private sceneObjects: SceneObject[] = []`. Desired behavior: keep one field. Expected result: create(), onStateChange() and the SHUTDOWN handler still use this.sceneObjects unchanged. Why: a duplicate class member is a compile error.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.ts, when searched for `private sceneObjects`, then exactly one match exists
Given a created BootScene with a mocked buildScene, when state changes, then every SceneObject.sync receives the state
Given SHUTDOWN is emitted, when handled, then every SceneObject.destroy is called
definition_of_done: One field remains and behavior is unchanged
